reviews.title: Best blocker I've tried, with one big loophole
reviews.text:
Refocus actually blocks websites, which most iPhone blockers don't do reliably. I also like the escalating strictness levels, from simple blocks all the way up to stopping you from deleting the apps.

The loophole is that changing the phone's time ends the block. Anyone determined to get around it will figure that out fast. Please keep an internal or server-based clock so a session can't be undone by changing the time. Fix that and it's 5 stars.

The way to reduce screen time is completely customizable, and I set it to not let me on TikTok after 7. If I want to, it’s really simple and I unblock it all the time, but only for a set amount of time (max is 8 hours) I do 20 minutes. This app made my life 10000% better! Please get this app

reviews.title: Refocus
reviews.text: Refocus- and the app just does that. I’m usually not one to use my phone often, I went without phone data for over 4 years. But after a traumatic experience, I found myself getting lost into social media, rabbit holes, negative content, I went from using my phone once every other day to multiple hours per day. The brain fog started, the anxiety and constant negative energy and thoughts surrounded me, and I knew I had to make a change to stop the path I was going down. This app genuinely helped me break that cycle. Within a week, I was feeling better. It’s been a month of using the Refocus app now, and I’m now down to only using my phone briefly once a day just for YouTube or a movie. This app truly does its job and helps break bad habits, but just like anything meant to help you, YOU yourself have to want it. You have to accept and want help to better yourself. You have to resist and use refocus as a reminder of your goal. It only really works if you actually put effort into changing your own habits. It is an amazing app, and I will keep using it. Thank you Refocus for helping me break the cycle and clear my mental!
